senses.gloss: c. (b. h.; קלל to swing) walking stick, in gen. staff.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 66a:17">Sabb. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ של זקנים</he> old men’s stick.
Kel. XVII, 16; Tosef. Kel. B. Mets. VII, 9 מ׳ שיש בו בית וכ׳ a staff which has a secret receptacle for a m’zuzah (מְזוּזָה) or jewels.

<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 3:1">Ab. Zar. III, 1</cite> <he>כל שיש בידו מ׳</he> a statue holding in its hand a staff; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 41a:4">ib. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>מ׳ שרודה את עצמו … כמ׳</he> the staff intimates symbolically that he causes himself to be chastised as with a staff in behalf of the entire world (vicarious sacrifice).

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 7:1:3">Y. Dem. VII, beg. 26ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>מהו דחמית בחלמי דמ׳ בלשי וכ׳</he> (not <he>דמיקל</he>) what does it mean that I saw in my dream an officer’s staff suspended from my body?—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 9:1:6">Y. Ned. IX, beg., 41ᵇ</cite> <he>מַקְלוֹ של ר״מ היתה וכ׳</he> R. Meir’s staff was in my hand, and it taught me knowledge.

<cite ref="Mishnah Tahorot 8:9">Toh. VIII, 9</cite> <he>מ׳ שהיא מלאה וכ׳</he> a staff which has become wet with unclean fluids; <cite ref="Tosefta Tahorot 9:15">Tosef. ib. IX, 15</cite> <he>מ׳ שהיה וכ׳</he> (corr. acc.); a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 139a:9">Sabb. 139ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 14:5">Is. XIV, 5</cite>) <he>אלו הדיינים שנעשו וכ׳</he> this alludes to judges who are a staff (of support) to their beadles (conniving at their abuses).—Pl. <he>מַקְלוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:9">R. Hash. I, 9</cite> <he>לוקחין בידם מ׳</he> they may take sticks with them (for defence); a. e.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 6:7">Yoma VI, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Yoma 67b:14">67ᵇ</cite>) <he>קלען במ׳</he> Y. ed. (Bab. a. Mish. <he>במקלעות</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 6) he twisted the limbs of the animals around carrying poles.
